subject: Lucy / ルーシー
model_scope: Asymmetric provisional appraisal/response reconstruction; no independent validity

rules.proposition: A believed unfinished obligation to a credited benefactor can bind persistence; accepted relevant information removing that dependency can permit departure without abandoning loyalty.
support: MAIN11 C3P542 own unpaid gratitude and concern for future victims
MAIN11 C3P548–557 credibility question, received claim and explicit lost attachment
contrary: Last-believer position is not independently audited
Megumin new-follower expectation and narrator sincerity interpretation retain their source layers
Lucy can leave while delivering a hostile retort
applies_when: Lucy recognizes the specific benefactor obligation
departure consequence and credibility of any received new information are supplied
do_not_assume: completed repayment or an invented family history
rules.confidence: Moderate local appraisal warrant; causal distinctiveness, thresholds and unfamiliar transfer weak.
rules.falsifier: Repeated persistence for an unrelated unprovided reason after accepted relevant duty-resolution, or repeated abandonment of a still-believed indispensable obligation without another supplied priority.

rules.proposition: Credited help can recruit gratitude and reciprocal concern, while direct factional insult/harm can recruit a retaliatory answer even during departure.
support: MAIN11 C3P533/536 stated doctrine and sect argument
MAIN11 C3P559–579 strike, anger, retort and final winning exit
contrary: She accepts a helpful stranger and leaves
Past divine actions are testimony, not repeated independent Lucy acts
applies_when: a helpful or hostile act is actually received
its dignity/faction meaning and available means are supplied
do_not_assume: a permanent new haunting after the retort
rules.confidence: Clear local acts; distinctive causal generality lower than LY-R01.
rules.falsifier: Repeated gratuitous humiliation of acknowledged helpers, or consistent unqualified acceptance of directly relevant affronts without reply/reappraisal or another supplied constraint.

scope_precision: Only the scope-assessment pointer is updated to the explicit aggregate-field synchronization successor. The two original rule objects and model/monograph bytes are unchanged before any input or first body.
